summary: Fidelity Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K on April 24, 2026, reporting routine monthly/quarterly distribution declarations (gross distributions of $0.1750 per share for Class I, S, and D, with a variable supplemental distribution of $0.0160 per share, payable May 29, 2026 to holders of record April 30, 2026) and its March 31, 2026 NAV per share ($24.95 for Class I and D, $24.93 for Class S), along with commentary on market conditions and fund performance. There are no special-situation corporate actions such as acquisitions, divestitures, tender offers, go-private, restructuring, or activist campaigns. This is a routine disclosure of dividends and financial results, not a transformative event. No deal terms apply.
